KERNEL__DATA_STORAGE_INTERRUPT: 10 clustered 'data storage interrupt'

claims.claim:
E0 contains 10 KERNEL FATAL 'data storage interrupt' records
        spanning nodes J14-U11 to J04-U01 at lines E0-L1 to E0-L10.

Pattern 'RAS KERNEL FATAL data storage interrupt' in E0 matches
        signature KERNEL__DATA_STORAGE_INTERRUPT also seen in E1 and E2.

E0 has 'data storage interrupt' at E0-L1 to E0-L10; E5 shows
